text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zimbabwe press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- One person was killed and 44 others injured in four separate accidents in Harare at the weekend.

- Private hospitals will have to be registered and have their fees approved by Zimbabwe's health ministry, among other things, if parliament approves a major shake-up in the administration of the country's health system.
- Exhibitors at the Zimbabwe International Trade Fair in Bulawayo have described it as a success in terms of the business deals they secured.
- Zimbabwe's ivory products manufacturing industry is threatened with collapse following a decision by management at the Department of National Parks and Wildlife to cut supplies.
